name: The Board
fit: Engineers, hardware, infra and AI builders
keywords: circuit pcb hardware electronics chip solder green copper
idea: The page is a populated circuit board. Sections are components, links are traces, the one red LED is the only live colour.
note: Live: blinking LED, signal flowing along the trace (stroke-dashoffset), chip hover.
borrowed: Printed circuit boards: green solder mask, copper ground pours, gold-plated (ENIG) pads, white silkscreen labels, reference designators like U1 and R12, mounting holes in the corners.
mood: Precise, engineered, quietly nerdy. Suits engineers, hardware and infra teams, AI builders, developer tools. Avoid for soft consumer brands.

type.meta: Data · B612 Mono, designators and numbers only

motion: Signal pulse: short dash on the trace path, `stroke-dasharray: 14 300`, linear 2.4s loop.
LED: `steps(2)` blink, never smooth. Hardware doesn't fade.
Hover lifts a component 3px with a gold outline ring.
watchouts: Keep a single accent (the LED). More reds turn it into a Christmas board.
Silk-dim on mask passes contrast only at 16px+.
Wide nav rows overflow on phones. Let them wrap.
